fields.value: Opening hours

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Getting here and parking

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We are in the Warrnambool CBD, a short walk from Coles, with paid street parking close by and free two-hour parking at the nearby shopping centre. Ground-floor access from the street.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: We look forward to welcoming patients from Port Fairy,

fields.label: Words
fields.value: We regularly see patients travelling in from Port Fairy,

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Koroit, Allansford, Dennington and the surrounding districts.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Joining the waitlist

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Booking an appointment

fields.label: Words
fields.value: We open in December 2026. To join the waitlist, or to ask anything before then,

fields.label: Words
fields.value: call

fields.label: Words
fields.value: or

fields.label: Words
fields.value: send us a message using the form below and we will get back to you.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Call

fields.label: Words
fields.value: during opening hours, or send

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Send

fields.label: Words
fields.value: us a message using the form below and we will get back to you on the next business day.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: From opening in December 2026, we will hold two same-day emergency appointments each day. Call

fields.label: Words
fields.value: first thing in the morning to secure one. Emergency appointments cannot be booked online.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: If you are in pain, please phone rather than email. We hold two same-day emergency appointments each day. Call

fields.label: Words
fields.value: first thing in the morning to secure one. Emergency appointments cannot be booked online.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: If you have a dental emergency outside our hours

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We do not offer after-hours care. If you have a dental emergency outside our opening hours, please go to the Emergency Department at South West Healthcare. For a significant facial injury, swelling that is affecting your breathing or swallowing, or uncontrolled bleeding, call 000.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Enquiry form

fields.label: Words
fields.value: I agree to Lava Street Dental contacting me about my enquiry, and I’ve read the Privacy Policy.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Send enquiry

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Please do not include detailed health information in this form. We will call you to discuss anything clinical.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Fees and health funds

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We will explain what treatment involves and what it costs before it goes ahead, and provide a written plan for anything more involved than routine care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Lava Street Dental accepts all private health funds and is not restricted to a preferred-provider network. Eligible patients can also access treatment through CDBS and DVA arrangements. Afterpay and humm payment plans are available to eligible patients. Provider terms, eligibility requirements and conditions apply. Health fund claims can be made on the spot with our Tyro terminal, and we accept card payments, Afterpay and humm.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Feedback

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If something has not gone the way it should have, we would rather hear it from you directly. Speak to Jaimee Griffiths or email {{email}} and we will look into it.
